rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is whole or entire.

example.traditional: 成個蛋糕畀我哋食晒啦。
example.jyutping: seng4 go3 daan6 gou1 bei2 ngo5 dei6 sik6 saai3 laa1

rows.note: Use this when stressing that something is complete or intact rather than only referring to all of it.

example.english: You have to hand in the entire document to the teacher, not just one page.
example.traditional: 你要將整份文件交畀老師，唔可以淨係交一頁。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 zoeng1 zing2 fan6 man4 gin6 gaau1 bei2 lou5 si1 m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 gaau1 jat1 jip6
